Tags: IGEL

Federico Pianzola @fpianz #1 2023-04-04 15:48 UTC

As many of you already know, the SSOL journal (Scientific Study of Literature) will have a new website soon. We’re thinking about the new styling and we’d like your input about possible ideas for the logo.

Here below are a few suggestions, feel free to vote for your favourites and leave a comment with additional suggestions (e.g. changing the font, colors, spacing…).
